_README: DRAFT gold set for concept-routing R4 eval — authored by Dispatch (Sam delegated this; VET + EXTEND before trusting the numbers). ~36 real Wylde developer questions paired with the source files that SHOULD ground the answer. Graded by file-path SUFFIX match (case-insensitive, forward-slash), so a path here matches a live chunk whose absolute path ends with it. `kind`: easy = one clear subsystem; conflation = a cosine would wrongly pull an adjacent same-named concept that a Negative 'IS NOT' edge should suppress (see `avoid_files`); dependency = a depended-on concept should be pulled in (see `dependency_files`). `concepts` is left empty: the LIVE concept store is 122 coarse auto-clusters with generic labels ('Src'/'Ipc'/'Deps'), so there is no clean concept label to assert against — that is itself an R4 finding. The controlled fixture corpus (harness tests) carries clean named concepts + authored relations for the mechanism proof.
